draft.title: Science, technology and engineering
card: Science builds knowledge by investigating and explaining the natural world.
Technology is the tools and products people make to solve problems. Engineers design and build them, often using scientific knowledge.
New technology can let science find out more. A better telescope can show galaxies that older telescopes could not detect.
New science can lead to new technology. Scientific knowledge about X-rays and magnetism helped lead to medical imaging machines.
draft.remember: Science and technology can help each other: tools extend what science finds, and findings can lead to new tools.

a.q: Which example shows new technology letting science find out more?
opts: A stronger microscope lets biologists see inside cells
Scientists study how light bends and later design a lens
Doctors use a scan to treat patients in a clinic
Engineers build a bridge using a known design
a.why: A stronger microscope is a new tool, and it lets scientists observe things they could not see before. The lens example is the other way round: science came first and led to a new product.
a.clue: Look for a new tool that gives scientists new observations.

b.q: Researchers in Perth learn how certain materials react to magnetic fields. Engineers then use this knowledge to build a new scanner for hospitals. What does this show?
opts: New science leading to new technology
New technology leading to new science
Engineering replacing the need for science
b.why: The scientific knowledge came first, and engineers used it to build the scanner. That is new science leading to new technology. It is not the reverse, because the scanner did not exist before the research.
b.clue: Which came first: the knowledge or the machine?

a.best: A stronger microscope lets biologists see inside cells

b.best: New science leading to new technology
